title: Yellow Pickle Spanish Chicken Wrap
description: A malty and snappy Spanish dish featuring dill pickles, perfect for a post-workout meal, wrapped in an agave leaf for a unique and eco-friendly vessel, inspired by the simplicity of Buddhist temple cuisine
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat with Spanish olive oil.
Add the chicken breast strips to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through.
Add the sliced dill pickles, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together the malt vinegar and water.
Pour the malt vinegar mixture over the chicken and pickle mixture in the skillet.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Prepare the agave leaves by washing and drying them thoroughly.
Spoon the chicken and pickle mixture onto the center of each agave leaf.
Fold the agave leaves over the filling to create a wrap, and serve immediately.
